content.short: Business accounts, corporate cards, payables and receivables for APAC companies.
content.description: Aspire, founded in 2018 and headquartered in Singapore, is an all-in-one business finance platform for startups and small-to-medium companies across Southeast Asia and beyond. It provides multi-currency business accounts, corporate and virtual cards, accounts payable and receivable automation, expense management, and foreign-exchange, all tied together with accounting integrations. Companies use Aspire to collect payments locally in multiple currencies, pay vendors and staff internationally, control team spend, and reconcile transactions automatically. By consolidating banking, cards, and spend management into a single dashboard, Aspire aims to replace the fragmented mix of bank accounts and tools that regional businesses traditionally juggle when operating across APAC markets.
